fullPassage: In their pre-predatory stage, our primate ancestors had moved through the world among other creatures that did not fear them. Once they adopted carnivory, the prey they were interested in learned to allow close approaches at their own risk. But unlike big cats or terrifying wolves that were obvious predators, upright primates didn't automatically fit the predator template for most animals. Numerous examples from around the world during the past five centuries testify that upon initially encountering humans, many wild creatures did not associate us with a threat. In their first encounters with humans, scores of species reacted with trust and tameness. There is a term of art for this: biological first contact. When we appeared in new geographies for the first time, wild animals had to learn to be afraid of us. Many died standing and looking, never absorbing the lesson.

questions.stem:
주어진 문장 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

(A) Numerous examples from around the world during the past five centuries testify that upon initially encountering humans, many wild creatures did not associate us with a threat. In their first encounters with humans, scores of species reacted with trust and tameness.

(B) Once they adopted carnivory, the prey they were interested in learned to allow close approaches at their own risk. But unlike big cats or terrifying wolves that were obvious predators, upright primates didn't automatically fit the predator template for most animals.

(C) There is a term of art for this: biological first contact. When we appeared in new geographies for the first time, wild animals had to learn to be afraid of us. Many died standing and looking, never absorbing the lesson.

det.korean: 영장류의 포식 이전 단계에서 시작하여 육식 채택, 야생동물의 반응, 생물학적 최초 접촉으로 이어지는 논리적 흐름
det.analysis:
① (A)-(C)-(B)
→ (A)는 '야생 생물이 인간을 위협과 연관 짓지 않았다'는 내용. 도입문 이후 바로 (A)가 오면 육식 채택 배경(B)이 빠져 논리 비약. 부적절

② (B)-(A)-(C) ← 정답
→ 도입문: 포식 이전 단계 → (B): 육식 채택 + 직립 영장류는 포식자 틀에 안 맞음 → (A): 그래서 야생동물이 인간을 위협으로 보지 않은 사례 + 신뢰·순종 반응 → (C): 이것(this)의 학술 용어 = biological first contact + 교훈 미흡수. 인과 흐름 완벽

③ (B)-(C)-(A)
→ (C)의 'this'가 (A)의 trust and tameness를 지칭하므로 (A) 뒤에 (C)가 와야 함. 부적절

④ (C)-(B)-(A)
→ (C)의 'this'가 선행 내용 없이 등장. 부적절
det.tip: (C)의 'There is a term of art for this'에서 this가 가리키는 내용((A)의 trust and tameness)을 파악하는 것이 핵심이다.

det.analysis:
본문: 'wild animals had to learn to be afraid of us'

한국어: '인간을 두려워하는 법을 배워야 했다'

정답: had to learn to be afraid of us
- had to = ~해야 했다 (과거 의무)
- learn to = ~하는 법을 배우다
- be afraid of = ~을 두려워하다
- us = 인간(우리)

구문: had to(조동사) + learn(V) + to be afraid of us(목적어인 to부정사구)
※ had to + learn + to V 구문에서 to가 두 번 나오는 구조
det.tip: had to = ~해야 했다. learn to = ~하는 법을 배우다. be afraid of = ~을 두려워하다.

questions.wa: had to learn to be afraid of us
accept: had to learn to be afraid of us

questions.passage: In their pre-predatory stage, our primate ancestors had moved through the world among other creatures that did not fear them. Once they adopted carnivory, __________. But unlike big cats or terrifying wolves that were obvious predators, upright primates didn't automatically fit the predator template for most animals. Numerous examples from around the world during the past five centuries testify that upon initially encountering humans, many wild creatures did not associate us with a threat. In their first encounters with humans, scores of species reacted with trust and tameness. There is a term of art for this: biological first contact. When we appeared in new geographies for the first time, wild animals had to learn to be afraid of us. Many died standing and looking, never absorbing the lesson.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸을 완성하시오.
'그들이 관심을 가진 먹이는 자기 위험을 감수하며 가까운 접근을 허용하는 법을 배웠다'
[조건] (1) the, prey, they, were, interested, in, learned, to, allow, close, approaches, at, their, own, risk를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 15단어 (영어로)

det.korean: 영장류가 육식을 채택한 후 먹이의 반응을 서술하는 영작
det.analysis:
본문: 'the prey they were interested in learned to allow close approaches at their own risk'

한국어: '그들이 관심을 가진 먹이는 자기 위험을 감수하며 가까운 접근을 허용하는 법을 배웠다'

정답: the prey they were interested in learned to allow close approaches at their own risk
- the prey = 먹이
- they were interested in = 그들이 관심을 가진 (관계절)
- learned to allow = 허용하는 법을 배웠다
- close approaches = 가까운 접근
- at their own risk = 자기 위험을 감수하며

구문: the prey(주어) + [they were interested in](관계절) + learned(V) + to allow(to부정사) + close approaches(목적어) + at their own risk(부사구)
det.tip: the prey they were interested in에서 관계대명사가 생략된 목적격 관계절 구조를 파악한다. at one's own risk = 자기 위험 부담으로.

questions.wa: the prey they were interested in learned to allow close approaches at their own risk
accept: the prey they were interested in learned to allow close approaches at their own risk
